mustUse: black-white contrast with clean white space
transparent glass panels over cool gray systems
wide desktop layouts around 1700-1750px on 1920px displays
soft boundaryless sections with obvious borders only for functional windows
centered and constrained heading/copy blocks for text-heavy sections
avoid: real brand-logo walls as the main case visual

palette.usage: Use black, white, and cool gray as the base. Add controlled accent colors such as cyan, Louder yellow, rose, and small electric highlights; do not make human portraits monochrome.

contentRules.companyName: Do not add a legal company name until confirmed.
contentRules.tone: International, direct, professional, focused on brand globalization and overseas market operations.
contentRules.customerFacingCopy: Avoid internal draft terms such as logo-free assets, placeholders, fake data, or implementation notes on public pages.

implementationRules.siteEntry: Repository root remains the deployment entry for now: index.html, styles.css, script.js, api/.
implementationRules.localOnlyFolder: workspace-local/ is ignored by git and used for reference PDFs, discarded assets, source captures, and previews.
implementationRules.preferenceLookup: Read this file before making future visual decisions.
